title: Workflow-tool publisher expands default-branch metadata directly in shell source
title_de: Workflow-Tool-Publisher expandiert Default-Branch-Metadaten direkt im Shell-Source
profile: Framework PR #39-#41 consolidation local workflow-security validation
affected_symbols: Revalidate the reusable Draft branch before modifying it
technical_claim: The write-capable workflow-tool publisher interpolated github.event.repository.default_branch directly into run-script source. Zizmor reports this as high-confidence template injection because template expansion precedes shell parsing. The remediated workflow supplies the value through reviewed step-local environment maps, quotes the variable at use sites, and validates it as a Git branch before ref construction.
entry_point: Scheduled or manual execution of update-workflow-tools.yml reaches the constrained publisher after resolver and validator success.
source_to_sink_or_broken_control: Source: direct GitHub expression interpolation in publisher run blocks. Potential sink: shell parsing and Git ref arguments in a contents:write/pull-requests:write job. Broken control: no reviewed environment boundary or ref-format validation before shell-source expansion.
attacker_prerequisites: A shell-significant default-branch metadata value reaches a trusted publisher run, or a future workflow broadens the metadata trust boundary.
The resolver and validator succeed and the publisher condition is satisfied.
observed_behavior: Checksum-verified zizmor --offline .github returned exit code 1 and reported four high-confidence template-injection findings at update-workflow-tools.yml lines 192, 202, 205, and 225 before remediation.
expected_behavior: Repository metadata must not be expanded directly into publisher shell source. The exact approved value must be carried as step-local data, safely quoted, validated as a branch ref, and bound by the publisher profile.
impact: The required workflow-security check fails. If a shell-significant value crosses this metadata boundary, it could alter commands in a token-bearing publisher. Current evidence does not claim an untrusted pull-request author can control repository default-branch metadata; this is treated as a release-blocking security hardening and CI-control failure until hosted verification.
root_cause: The updater used GitHub expression syntax inside shell run blocks instead of a reviewed environment mapping and quoted variable expansion.
proposed_remediation: Use exact step-local DEFAULT_BRANCH environment mappings, validate them with git check-ref-format --branch, use only quoted shell-variable references, update the publisher profile/digests, and retain independent resolver/validator gates and least-privilege permissions.
acceptance_criteria: No direct github.event.repository.default_branch expression remains in an update-workflow-tools run block.
Both affected publisher steps have exactly reviewed DEFAULT_BRANCH environment maps.
The maintenance-branch step validates DEFAULT_BRANCH with git check-ref-format --branch before constructing refs.
The exact publisher profile and all static workflow security controls pass.
The exact hosted consolidation PR passes the applicable workflow-security checks before merge.
validation_plan: Run checksum-verified zizmor --offline .github before and after the repair.
Run check-ci-security-contract.py, check-github-actions-workflows.py --check all, and focused CI-security tests.
Verify hosted workflow-lint and exact PR-head checks after publication.
legitimate_control_tests: The unchanged constrained publisher profile passes the CI-security contract.
The post-fix offline zizmor scan has no active findings.
The normal default-branch condition and quoted Git ref handling remain intact.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped GitHub PR/check/review/thread readback plus retained hosted verification receipt
evidence.summary: The corrected PR #42 head 1fd3b362e0fed9766c6920e3c7bd1939535850f2 passes hosted workflow lint, Zizmor, Sonar PR Quality Gate, and all other applicable controls.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped checksum-verified zizmor --offline .github before and after the workflow remediation
evidence.summary: The pre-fix scan reported four high-confidence template-injection findings; the post-fix scan reports no active findings.

evidence.command: RTK-wrapped clean-worktree, exact range whitespace, and native make lint verification after committing the consolidation head
evidence.summary: The locally fixed publisher metadata-boundary remediation is bound to committed Framework head 22747d460a9f7be02760edf05c311be376492457; hosted exact-head evidence remains required.

evidence_limitations: The evidence is static local scanning and does not prove a hostile party can set repository default-branch metadata.
No token-bearing publisher, GitHub workflow, or remote action was invoked during validation.
residual_risk: The publisher metadata-boundary repair passed the applicable hosted controls on the exact open PR #42 head but is not yet integrated into Framework master. It remains fixed, not verified or closed, until a normal master integration and resulting-master evidence. FND-SONAR-0002 remains an independent master-integration blocker.

history.detail: Open Framework PR #42 head 1fd3b362e0fed9766c6920e3c7bd1939535850f2 passed hosted workflow lint/Zizmor, Sonar PR Quality Gate, and all other applicable controls. This strengthens the fixed disposition, but the finding is neither verified nor closed before normal master integration and resulting-master evidence.

The locally fixed publisher metadata-boundary repair is now bound to Framework commit 22747d460a9f7be02760edf05c311be376492457. Clean-worktree, exact-range whitespace, and native make lint validation passed; hosted exact-head evidence remains required.

Four high-confidence direct-expression findings in the token-bearing updater publisher were replaced with reviewed environment mappings, ref-format validation, quoted expansion, and updated exact publisher contracts; post-fix zizmor passed locally.
